personality_one_liner: A highly legible, high-contrast, professional, and blue-collar-friendly utility platform prioritizing immediate readability, clear primary actions, and an Uber-like marketplace efficiency.

spacing.rule: Generous spacing. Use safe area at screen root. No dense dashboard packing; allow touch targets to be oversized (min 48pt for primary buttons). Cards fill row horizontally.

do's: Use glass on bottom tab bar
Use glass on sticky headers over scrolling job feeds
Use glass on floating bottom sheets (e.g., job application modal)
dont's: Do not use glass on regular list rows or job cards
Do not use glass on form inputs or empty states

screens.name: Splash
screens.purpose: Brand presentation with a full-bleed construction site imagery.

states.loading: Shows logo centered over full-bleed site image with gradient bottom scrim.

screens.layout: Full-bleed expo-image (site_hero). Vertical gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse at 80% opacity) positioned bottom. App logo and 'India\'s Construction Network' title at the bottom 20%, text styled as onSurfaceInverse.

screens.name: Role Selection
screens.purpose: Allow user to identify as Worker, Contractor, or Client before signup.
screens.layout: Large headline at top. Three large vertical cards. Each card uses `surfaceSecondary`, a left-aligned icon in a `brandTertiary` tinted circle, bold title, and short description. A sticky 'Continue' CTA placed at the bottom inside a KeyboardAvoidingView/SafeArea.

screens.name: Login/OTP
screens.purpose: Authenticate users securely using mobile number.

states.error: Red warning text below input field, shake animation if possible.

screens.layout: Clean, distraction-free. Headline 'Enter Mobile Number'. Large, single-line text input with standard border. 'Send OTP' primary CTA anchored to the bottom (sticky thumb zone).

screens.name: Worker Home (Job Feed)
screens.purpose: Primary marketplace feed showing nearby jobs based on worker skills.

states.empty: Illustration of binoculars + 'No jobs found nearby. Update your skills or location.' + 'Update Profile' CTA.

screens.layout: Top: Sticky header with search bar (magnifying glass) + location dropdown. Feed: Vertical scroll of Job Cards. Job Card: `surface` with subtle shadow/border, Contractor Logo/Initials (left), Job Title (bold, lg), Location pin + distance, Wage badge (Amber bg + black text). Bottom of card: 'Apply' button. Bottom Tab Bar is present.

screens.name: Job Detail
screens.purpose: Deep dive into job requirements, expectations, and contractor details.
screens.layout: Top hero section with contractor logo or site image (scrim). Content: Job Title, 'Posted 2h ago', horizontal scroll of skill chips (e.g. Mason, Plumber) in `surfaceSecondary` capsules. Details list. Sticky bottom container with glassmorphism + 'Apply for Job' full-width primary CTA.

screens.name: Attendance (GPS + Selfie)

states.error: Out of geofence warning or face not detected.

screens.layout: Instant action. Full-screen Camera overlay (expo-camera) taking 85% of screen. A face outline frame. Bottom 15% sheet containing Real-Time GPS data (Lat/Lng), Location Verification Status badge (Green/Red), and a large primary Check-in button.

screens.name: Profile & Skills
screens.purpose: Allow workers to list their expertise and expected daily wage.
screens.layout: Header with Avatar image picker. Form layout: Name, Mobile. Skills section: Multi-select grid of selectable chips (surfaceTertiary for unselected, brandSecondary for selected). Expected Wage input. Sticky 'Save' CTA.

screens.name: Wallet / Referral
screens.purpose: Display gamified badges and referral earnings.

states.empty: Zero balance state with 'Refer a friend' hero illustration.

screens.layout: Top: Gamified Hero card using brandPrimary gradient background. Shows Total Earnings in oversized text. Below: Badges section (Bronze/Silver/Gold icons). Below: Recent transactions list.

site_hero.alt: Aerial view of active modern construction site with machinery

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the WCAG guidelines; since the target user base is blue-collar workers in India, ensure all fonts are properly sized (Base text at 16pt, titles at 22-28pt).
DO NOT use blue, indigo, or purple. Stick to the brand palette mapping provided (Amber primary against Charcoal black text/bg).
Implement the 'Sticky CTA' pattern meticulously. Actions like 'Verify OTP', 'Apply for Job', and 'Check In' MUST be anchored to the bottom using KeyboardAvoidingView with Safe Area considered.
For the Attendance feature, implement the camera layout directly as a full-screen view overlaid with GPS coordinates data at the bottom, just like human verification apps.

Job Feed cards must be built with structural clarity: salary and role highlighted as prominent 'badges', and Contractor logos mapped accurately. Use the provided real skill images as fallback or header backgrounds.
All full-bleed background images MUST use the 3-stop gradient scrim to guarantee text legibility.
Do not use generic emojis anywhere in the app interface.
